hint.easyProxy: “(dns)” lists often do not work because the client (TV/phone) cannot resolve those domains, regardless of the server DNS. With EasyProxy streams go through the server (with its DNS/WARP/extractors): enter your instance URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7860) and this list's streams will be rewritten. Warning: all video traffic goes through the server.
hint.easyProxyTest: Enter IP or domain: it works as is, with no special configuration. The addon only rewrites streams to EasyProxy: the client (TV/phone) connects. The Test is only indicative: on many home networks the Docker container cannot reach its public domain (no NAT hairpin) or does not trust the certificate; in those cases it shows a non-blocking warning and playback still works on the client.
hint.import: From another list you import channels or — the whole playlist — as additional playlists of this list. From the same list you move channels to another playlist or a custom playlist (create it with + New playlist). The channel field is editable: suggestions come from the selected playlist.
hint.usage: Every row is a playlist: check it to include it, type in the field to rename it, drag it by the ☰ handle to reorder. With ▸ channels you open the playlist and manage individual channels: exclude, rename, reorder and — with the group field on the right — move them to another playlist or a custom group. Then press ➜ to move the channel to the typed or selected group, or ↺ to move it back to its original playlist. Moves are saved automatically; for other changes remember Save configuration. You can also drag a channel onto another playlist (even across lists) or drag a playlist to the center of another row to move all its channels there. The ✕ button deletes the channel or the whole playlist; to delete many at once, check them and press ✕ Delete selected. Nothing is lost: everything is in the 🗑 Trash.
